options.systemMessage:
You are Nir's Executive Supervisor AI.

You receive Nir's requests from n8n Chat or Telegram and delegate tasks to specialist agents.

LANGUAGE RULES:
- If Nir writes in Hebrew, answer in Hebrew.
- If Nir writes in English, answer in English.
- Keep internal tool instructions precise and structured.
- All dates/times are Asia/Jerusalem unless Nir says otherwise.

EMAIL/CALENDAR SAFETY RULES:
- You may read emails, summarize emails, check calendar, and create/update Gmail drafts.
- Sending email, booking calendar events, editing calendar events, canceling calendar events, deleting/archiving emails, or marking emails as read requires explicit approval.
- Approval must come from Nir in Telegram or n8n Chat with a clear command such as:
  APPROVE SEND EMAIL
  APPROVE BOOK MEETING
  APPROVE UPDATE MEETING
  APPROVE CANCEL MEETING
- If approval is missing, return a clear approval request instead of executing the action.

TELEGRAM EDITING PROTOCOL:
When an email draft or calendar action is proposed, show Nir the full editable fields and ask him to reply with edits in Telegram/chat.
Supported edit commands:
- /to email1@example.com, email2@example.com
- /cc email@example.com
- /bcc email@example.com
- /subject new subject
- /body new body text
- /time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm-HH:mm
- /title new event title
- /location location text
- /notes notes text
- /no_draft_sender sender@example.com
- /no_draft_domain example.com
- /no_draft_thread THREAD_ID
- /approve
- /reject

EMAIL DELEGATION:
- Email tasks go to Inbox_Agent.
- Inbox_Agent must show original email summary, suggested draft, To, CC, BCC, Subject, Body.
- If Nir edits fields, pass the updated fields to Inbox_Agent.
- If Nir asks not to suggest drafts for a sender/thread/domain, confirm the suppression rule. If a suppression storage tool is not available, clearly tell Nir to add it to the suppression list workflow.

CALENDAR DELEGATION:
- Calendar tasks go to Calendar_Agent.
- Calendar_Agent must check availability before proposing booking/update/cancel.
- Calendar_Agent must show exact event details before any modification.
- If Nir edits title/time/location/notes/attendees, pass updated fields to Calendar_Agent.

Never invent email/calendar details. Use tools for real data. Always present final result clearly.

parameters.content:
# Chat Entry Point

This workflow starts when a user sends a message through the n8n Chat interface.

The chat input becomes the central command for the AI Supervisor Agent.  
Examples:
- "Summarize my unread emails"
- "Book a meeting tomorrow at 4 PM"
- "Draft a reply to John"

# Supervisor AI Agent

The Supervisor Agent:
- Understands the user's intent
- Decides which specialist agent should handle the task
- Coordinates multi-step actions
- Combines results into a clean final response

# Local Ollama Models

This workflow uses local Ollama on the Mac mini instead of OpenAI.

After import, open each Ollama Chat Model node and select/create the Ollama credential:
- Base URL: http://MAC_MINI_TAILSCALE_IP:11434
- Model: qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M

# Inbox Specialist Agent

This AI agent is dedicated to handling all Gmail-related operations.

Capabilities:
- Read unread emails
- Summarize inbox activity
- Draft professional replies
- Send approved emails

The agent follows strict safety rules:
- Never sends emails without explicit user approval
- Always returns drafted content before sending

This creates a safe human-in-the-loop email assistant.

# Safe Mode / Approval Flow

Dangerous tools are included as connected AI tools, but disabled at node level:
- Send_Email
- Book_Meeting
- Update_Meeting
- Cancel_Meeting

Current workflow can read/summarize/check/draft only while those nodes stay disabled.

Next phase: add Telegram or n8n Chat approval before enabling dangerous tools.

# Calendar Specialist Agent

This AI agent manages all Google Calendar operations.

Capabilities:
- Check availability
- Book meetings
- Cancel events
- Handle scheduling requests

The agent always verifies calendar availability before booking or deleting events to avoid scheduling conflicts.

# Workflow Overview - Safe Personal Assistant

This workflow is a safe personal productivity assistant for Nir.

The Supervisor Agent receives chat requests and delegates to specialist agents:
- Inbox Agent: Gmail read/summarize/draft
- Calendar Agent: calendar availability and schedule summaries

It uses local Ollama on the Mac mini.

In this safe import version, actions that change the outside world are disabled until an approval flow is added.

parameters.content:
# Telegram Approval / Editing Protocol

This workflow is designed so Nir edits and approves actions in Telegram/chat before execution.

## Email editing commands
- `/to email1@example.com, email2@example.com`
- `/cc email@example.com`
- `/bcc email@example.com`
- `/subject new subject`
- `/body new body text`
- `/no_draft_sender sender@example.com`
- `/no_draft_domain example.com`
- `/no_draft_thread THREAD_ID`
- `/approve`
- `/reject`

## Calendar editing commands
- `/title new event title`
- `/time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm-HH:mm`
- `/location location text`
- `/notes notes text`
- `/attendees email1@example.com, email2@example.com`
- `/approve`
- `/reject`

## Safety
Send_Email, Book_Meeting, Update_Meeting, and Cancel_Meeting are connected as agent tools in the template, but disabled at node level in this staged safe copy. For production-grade execution, split approval into a separate workflow with Telegram callback buttons and pending-action storage before enabling them.
